name: n8n
tagline: Fair-Code Workflow Automation & AI Agent Orchestrator
shortDescription: Node-based workflow automation tool with 400+ integrations and native LangChain AI agent workflows that you can self-host with unlimited executions.
pros: Zero per-step or per-task tax—run millions of webhook & AI operations for a flat $5–$10/mo VPS cost
Multi-step branching, loops, custom JavaScript/Python code nodes included free
Native AI Agent, Vector Store, and local Ollama LLM integration
Full data residency for HIPAA/GDPR compliance
cons: Requires setting up reverse proxy (Caddy/Traefik) or using a 1-click Hostinger/Coolify template for HTTPS webhooks
High-concurrency webhook bursts require Redis queue mode and Postgres

name: Coolify
tagline: Self-Hosted Open-Source Alternative to Heroku, Vercel & Netlify
shortDescription: Turn any $5 VPS into your own Vercel/Heroku PaaS with automatic Git push deployments, free Let's Encrypt SSL, and 1-click databases.
pros: No $20/seat developer tax—invite your entire engineering team for $0 extra
Deploy Next.js, Node, Python, Go, Docker Compose, Postgres, Redis, and 200+ 1-click services
Built-in automated S3 database & volume backups
Manage multiple remote servers from a single control plane
cons: Build spikes (like Next.js/TypeScript compilation) need at least 4GB RAM or swap space enabled
You are responsible for basic OS updates on the underlying VPS

name: Supabase
tagline: The Open-Source Firebase Alternative Built on PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Full Postgres database with instant REST/GraphQL APIs, Authentication, Row-Level Security, Realtime subscriptions, Edge Functions, and S3-compatible Storage.
dockerCommand: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/supabase/supabase && cd supabase/docker && docker compose up -d
pros: Unlimited Auth MAUs, database rows, and egress bandwidth within your VPS allocation
100% standard PostgreSQL with pgvector for AI embeddings out of the box
Supported as a 1-click template in Coolify and Hostinger VPS
Never get hit by surprise serverless read/write billing spikes
cons: Full Docker stack runs ~12 containers (Kong, GoTrue, PostgREST, Studio, Postgres) requiring at least 4GB RAM
Database high-availability & point-in-time recovery require manual pgBackRest/WAL-G setup

name: Plausible Analytics
tagline: Lightweight, Cookie-Free Open-Source Google Analytics Alternative
shortDescription: Privacy-friendly, GDPR-compliant web analytics (<1KB script) backed by ClickHouse for blazing-fast real-time traffic and conversion insights.
dockerCommand: git clone https://github.com/plausible/community-edition && cd community-edition && docker compose up -d

calculator.unitLabel: Monthly Pageviews Across All Sites (in hundreds of thousands)

pros: Track unlimited domains and tens of millions of monthly pageviews on a single $5–$7 VPS
No annoying GDPR cookie banners required
Sub-1KB script loads fast and bypasses many adblockers when proxied on your domain
Clean single-page dashboard with UTM, goal conversion, and Search Console integration
cons: Uses ClickHouse database which prefers at least 4GB RAM for smooth aggregations
Community Edition releases twice a year compared to rolling Cloud updates

name: Umami
tagline: Ultra-Lightweight Privacy Web & Event Analytics
shortDescription: Fast, MIT-licensed web and custom event analytics that runs on PostgreSQL or MySQL with minimal RAM overhead.

calculator.unitLabel: Monthly Tracked Events & Pageviews (in hundreds of thousands)

pros: Extremely low memory footprint—runs comfortably on a 1GB–2GB RAM VPS alongside other apps
Permissive MIT license allows white-labeling for client agencies
Built-in funnel analysis, retention reports, and custom user properties
cons: At 50M+ monthly events, PostgreSQL requires index tuning compared to ClickHouse

name: PostHog
tagline: All-in-One Open-Source Product Analytics, Session Replay & Feature Flags
shortDescription: Complete product OS combining event analytics, session recordings, feature flags, A/B testing, and user surveys.
pros: Replaces 4 separate SaaS subscriptions (Mixpanel, FullStory, LaunchDarkly, Typeform)
Keep sensitive user session replays on your own isolated infrastructure
cons: Requires at least 8GB–16GB RAM VPS due to ClickHouse, Kafka, and Redis services
PostHog Cloud already has a generous free tier (1M events/mo free) for small teams

name: Immich
tagline: High-Performance Self-Hosted Google Photos & iCloud Replacement
shortDescription: Self-hosted photo and video backup solution with native iOS/Android mobile auto-backup, facial recognition, and AI smart search.

calculator.unitLabel: Family / Team Cloud Storage Needed (in ratusan GB / Terabytes)

pros: Polished iOS and Android apps that feel identical to Google Photos
Local machine-learning CLIP search ('dog on a beach at sunset') and facial clustering
Full original quality without cloud compression or privacy scanning
cons: Initial ML facial recognition indexing uses significant CPU/RAM
Always pair your VPS with an automated off-site backup (e.g. Backblaze B2 or Hetzner Storage Box)

name: Ghost
tagline: Open-Source Publishing, Newsletter & Paid Membership Platform
shortDescription: Modern headless/full-stack publishing and newsletter platform with 0% platform transaction fees on paid Stripe memberships.
pros: Keep 100% of your paid newsletter revenue (Substack takes a massive 10% cut forever!)
Built-in SEO, schema markup, AMP, and native newsletter sending via Mailgun/SES
Blazing fast Node.js runtime compared to bloated WordPress plugins
cons: Bulk email delivery requires connecting a Mailgun or AWS SES account

name: Listmonk
tagline: High-Performance Self-Hosted Newsletter & Mailing List Manager
shortDescription: Single-binary Go newsletter and transactional email manager backed by Postgres that sends millions of emails via Amazon SES for pennies.
pros: Cuts email marketing bills by 95% when paired with AWS SES, Postmark, or SendGrid
Uses less than 100MB of RAM because it is written in compiled Go
Supports SQL-based subscriber segmentation, bounce webhooks, and transactional templates
cons: Does not include a drag-and-drop visual workflow builder (focused on fast campaigns & transactional APIs)

name: NocoDB
tagline: Open-Source Airtable Alternative That Turns Any SQL DB into a Smart Spreadsheet
shortDescription: Connects to any Postgres, MySQL, or SQLite database and provides rich Grid, Kanban, Gallery, Form, and Calendar views with instant REST APIs.
pros: Eliminates Airtable's $24/user/month seat pricing AND 50,000 record-per-base ceiling
Stores data in real PostgreSQL so your database scales to millions of rows
Built-in webhook automations for Slack, Discord, Email, and n8n
cons: Complex Airtable scripting extensions need to be rewritten as webhooks or API calls

name: Chatwoot
tagline: Open-Source Omnichannel Customer Support & Intercom Alternative
shortDescription: Unified live chat widget, AI help center, Email, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Telegram support inbox without per-agent seat gouging.
pros: Saves $5,000–$25,000/yr compared to Intercom or Zendesk for growing support teams
Includes Captain AI assistant, public Help Center docs, and WhatsApp Business integration
1-click deployment available on DigitalOcean, Hostinger, and Coolify
cons: Ruby on Rails + Sidekiq background workers require at least 4GB RAM to avoid swap thrashing

name: Twenty CRM
tagline: Modern Open-Source CRM Alternative to Salesforce, HubSpot & Attio
shortDescription: Fast, keyboard-first modern CRM with custom objects, Kanban pipelines, email sync, and GraphQL/REST APIs.
pros: Lightning-fast Notion/Linear-inspired UI that sales teams actually enjoy using
No forced $1,000+ annual HubSpot onboarding fees or contact-tier price hikes
Full data ownership and custom object modeling
cons: Marketing automation emails are best handled via integration with Listmonk or n8n

name: Outline
tagline: Fast, Collaborative Team Knowledge Base & Notion/Confluence Alternative
shortDescription: Blazing-fast markdown wiki with real-time multiplayer editing, Slack integration, SSO, and instant full-text search.
pros: Loads pages in <50ms—significantly faster than Notion for large engineering handbooks
Native Markdown storage, slash commands, Mermaid diagrams, and backlinking
Includes Google Workspace, OIDC, and Slack login without an 'Enterprise SSO Tax'
cons: Requires setting up an OAuth provider (Google, GitHub, Discord, or Keycloak) during first-time setup

name: Plane
tagline: Open-Source Project Management Alternative to Jira, Linear & Asana
shortDescription: Modern issue tracking, sprint cycles, roadmaps, and project wiki pages built for product and engineering teams.
pros: Combines issue tracking (Linear/Jira) and project documentation (Notion/Confluence) in one app
1-click importers from Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues, and Asana
Full sprint velocity analytics, Gantt views, and time tracking
cons: Needs at least 4GB RAM for Next.js frontend + Django API + Postgres + Redis containers

name: Cal.com
tagline: Open-Source Scheduling Infrastructure & Calendly Alternative
shortDescription: Customizable meeting scheduling with round-robin routing, Stripe paid bookings, Google/Outlook sync, and white-label embeds.
dockerCommand: git clone --recursive https://github.com/calcom/docker.git && cd docker && docker compose up -d
pros: Free forever for individuals and saves $16/user/month for sales & recruiting teams
Supports collective events, round-robin lead routing, and workflow reminders
Accept Stripe payments directly on booking pages
cons: Setting up your own Google Calendar OAuth credentials in Google Cloud Console takes ~15 minutes

name: Documenso
tagline: The Open-Source DocuSign & PandaDoc Alternative
shortDescription: Legally binding cryptographic PDF document signing with reusable templates, webhooks, and custom branding.
pros: No artificial 100-envelope annual caps like DocuSign imposes on standard plans
Embed signing flows directly inside your own SaaS application via API
Standard X.509 digital certificate signing for verifiable audit trails
cons: Requires generating or mounting a signing certificate (.p12) for cryptographic verification

name: Vaultwarden
tagline: Lightweight Rust Bitwarden Server & 1Password Alternative
shortDescription: Unofficial Bitwarden-compatible server written in Rust that runs on minimal RAM and unlocks organization sharing, TOTP, and passkeys.
pros: Works seamlessly with all official Bitwarden iOS, Android, Chrome, macOS, and Windows apps
Uses only ~25MB of RAM—can share a $4.50 VPS with 5 other tools
Includes TOTP 2FA authenticator, emergency access, and organization collections free
cons: Requires HTTPS (handled automatically by Caddy, Cloudflare Tunnel, or Coolify) for WebCrypto browser extensions

name: Uptime Kuma
tagline: Self-Hosted Uptime Monitoring & Status Page Alternative to Pingdom/BetterStack
shortDescription: Beautiful self-hosted monitoring tool for HTTP(s), TCP, DNS, Docker containers, and SSL expiry with 90+ notification channels.

calculator.unitLabel: Monitored Endpoints & Public Status Pages (in tens)

pros: 20-second check intervals and unlimited public branded status pages for $0 extra
Instant alerts to Slack, Telegram, Discord, PagerDuty, Teams, and Webhook
Zero external database dependencies (uses embedded SQLite)
cons: Best hosted on an independent cheap VPS outside your primary production cluster so it can alert if production goes down

name: Meilisearch
tagline: Lightning-Fast Rust Search Engine & Algolia Alternative
shortDescription: Typo-tolerant, sub-50ms instant search and AI hybrid vector search engine that drops straight into e-commerce and SaaS apps.

calculator.unitLabel: Monthly Search Requests & Indexed Records (in hundreds of thousands)

pros: No per-search-request metered billing—users can type-ahead search without racking up a $500 Algolia bill
Zero configuration typo-tolerance, synonyms, faceted filtering, and geo-search
Supports hybrid semantic + keyword search with OpenAI or local embeddings
cons: Memory-mapped index performs best when dataset fits comfortably in VPS RAM

name: Nextcloud Hub
tagline: Complete Self-Hosted Google Workspace & Microsoft 365 Alternative
shortDescription: Private cloud file sync, real-time Docs/Sheets editing, Calendar, Mail, and video calls in one unified workspace.
pros: Replaces Google Drive, Docs, Calendar, and Zoom with zero per-user licensing fees
Desktop and mobile auto-sync clients for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android
Over 300+ modular apps in the Nextcloud App Store
cons: Collabora Online document editing container needs at least 4GB–8GB RAM for smooth multi-user editing

name: Mattermost
tagline: Secure Open-Source Team Messaging & Slack / Microsoft Teams Alternative
shortDescription: High-trust team chat, voice calls, screen sharing, and DevOps playbooks with unlimited message history.
dockerCommand: git clone https://github.com/mattermost/docker && cd docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.without-nginx.yml up -d
pros: Never lose access to chat history older than 90 days (unlike Slack's crippled free tier)
Slack-compatible incoming/outgoing webhook format makes migration effortless
Built-in voice calls, screen sharing, and incident response playbooks
cons: Mobile push notifications on self-hosted instances use Mattermost's TPNS relay or custom push proxy

name: Typebot
tagline: Open-Source Conversational Forms & Typeform / Landbot Alternative
shortDescription: Visual drag-and-drop conversational form and AI lead-generation chatbot builder that boosts conversion rates by up to 3x.
pros: Collect unlimited form responses and chat leads without Typeform's steep response tier paywalls
Native blocks for OpenAI, Google Sheets, Stripe payments, Cal.com, and webhooks
Embed as popup, bubble, or full-page form on any website or WhatsApp
cons: Requires configuring S3/MinIO storage if your forms accept user file uploads

name: Metabase
tagline: Fast, Open-Source Business Intelligence & Tableau / Looker Alternative
shortDescription: Connects to Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, or BigQuery so anyone on your team can build interactive dashboards without knowing SQL.
pros: Give every employee in your company access to live BI dashboards for $0/seat
Automated daily Slack and Email KPI digest reports
Visual query builder + full SQL editor with parameterized variables
cons: Runs on the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), so allocate at least 2GB–4GB RAM to the container

name: Penpot
tagline: Open-Source Web-Based UI/UX Design & Prototyping Alternative to Figma
shortDescription: First open-source design tool built on native web standards (SVG & CSS Grid/Flexbox) so designers and developers speak the same language.
dockerCommand: curl -o docker-compose.yaml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/penpot/penpot/main/docker/images/docker-compose.yaml && docker compose -p penpot -f docker-compose.yaml up -d
pros: Eliminates Figma's controversial 'Dev Mode' seat fees for engineers inspecting designs
Native CSS Grid and Flexbox layout engine generates production-ready code
Keep confidential product prototypes on your own private server
cons: Community plugin ecosystem is growing rapidly but smaller than Figma's marketplace
